_about: Jarvis's sonic vocabulary. Each entry maps a conversational EVENT (which the brain already emits on /events) to a sound from the foley library. The design intent: the words carry the content, these carry the STATE — like a console, not a soundtrack. Rare enough that each one means something.
_timing: Sounds fire at SENTENCE BOUNDARIES, never mid-word — the client already chunks speech by sentence, so an event that arrives mid-sentence queues its sound for the next boundary. This is the rule that makes it read as language rather than as noise.
_trim: Sources marked with `trim` are longer than the punctuation they are doing; the panel serves the first N seconds.

ack.sound: CB_Sounddesign - Applicable Sounds - Organic UI and Building Games SFX/UIMisc_Kalimba 3 Up_CB Sounddesign_APPlicable Sounds.opus

think.when: the model is generating; delegated work is running

found.sound: Computer Device Power Up Activation Conformation Lo-Fi 06.opus

verify.sound: UIAlert_Collect Scifi Futuristic Electronic Bass Burst Sweep Heavy 04_ESM_FG2.opus

fault.when: brain emits job_failed, media_error, or a refused tool call

present.means: here is the thing you asked to hear
present.when: brain emits media (about to play sound or music)

shift.means: I am changing something about myself
shift.when: brain emits a voice change (session voice field)

bed.means: he is in the room, working
bed.when: loops under the whole time he is thinking; never on a turn of its own

impact.when: a plan arrives for approval — the reference clip's sub-bass hit

_silence: Deliberately absent: a sound for every turn of conversation, a sound over the top of his own speech, and anything on the phone line. A vocabulary only works because it is not used constantly.
_layers: Three layers, after the reference clip: a BED (a server-room hum that loops while he works — the reference's buzzing texture), IMPACTS (sub-bass thuds that land a significant moment — 57-140 Hz in the reference), and STINGS (short discrete punctuation for quick state changes). The reference has no beeps at all: its language is texture and weight.
